parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been building bathhouses/steam baths for 1000s of years.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There were new ways to build community and identity, bringing this increasingly diverse population together with shared rituals and activities. This included the use of a steam house or sauna.
parsed.reason: The page confirms a Bronze Age community in Scotland utilized a steam house or sauna, substantiating the claim that Europeans built steam baths thousands of years ago.
